mission: To build and operate the system that allows GPC to deliver profitably and predictably by owning capacity, profitability, operational controls, company reporting, account hygiene, and cross-functional accountability. The Ops Manager doesn't personally manage every project or client; they ensure the people who own those outcomes have the information, resources, systems, and accountability required to succeed.
capacity: All time logged in ClickUp daily. Core operating metrics updated before every weekly leadership review. Flag Grant in advance if a week is trending past your contracted hours.

kpis.name: 1. Accounts at Target Margin
kpis.calculation: Active accounts meeting company gross-margin target ÷ total active accounts

kpis.name: 2. Delivery Utilization
kpis.calculation: Productive/assigned delivery hours ÷ available delivery hours

kpis.name: 3. Operating Data Accuracy
kpis.calculation: Active accounts with complete, reconciled revenue, cost, hours, contract, owner, health, and renewal data ÷ total active accounts

kpis.name: 4. Client Health Rate
kpis.calculation: Green/healthy accounts ÷ total active accounts, paired with NPS

outcomes.what: Current revenue, cost, and profitability reporting
outcomes.howMeasured: 100% of active accounts logged in Airtable with accurate data; accounts below target margin identified and escalated with a corrective action; no material profitability issue unidentified for more than one reporting cycle

outcomes.what: A forward-looking view of delivery capacity
outcomes.howMeasured: Rolling capacity forecast updated weekly, PTO/OOO reflected; when backlog exceeds two weeks or utilization exceeds 80% for two consecutive weeks, leadership gets a staffing recommendation within 48 hours

outcomes.what: One trustworthy view of company operating performance
outcomes.howMeasured: Core operating metrics updated before leadership review; delivery, profitability, capacity, and client-health data reconcile to source systems; no recurring manual reporting process stays undocumented

outcomes.what: An accurate operating record of every active client
outcomes.howMeasured: 100% of active accounts have accurate client name, product/service, contract value, start/end date, engagement owner, PM, renewal date, health status, and account status, reconciled across ClickUp, CRM, and profitability reporting

Billable/non-billable policy documented and applied; scope exceptions resolved before creating material unplanned work; material commercial exceptions get leadership approval; no engineer makes an independent commercial concession

outcomes.what: Visibility into which accounts are healthy, at risk, or renewing
outcomes.howMeasured: 100% of active accounts have a current health status; renewal dates visible forward-looking; at-risk accounts have a named owner; NPS collected from ≥90% of eligible clients quarterly, company NPS ≥8/10, every score below 8 has an owner and corrective action within 5 business days

outcomes.what: An operating system for company knowledge, without owning every SOP personally
outcomes.howMeasured: Every critical process has a named SOP owner and review date; process changes trigger a review; overdue or missing SOPs get assigned; repeated tribal-knowledge issues get documented
PTO processed per policy; upcoming OOO visible to impacted teams; coverage risks communicated to PMs; resource conflicts addressed before affecting client commitments

Collect any 4 company-wide growth actions per quarter (video testimonial, case study, referral resulting in a qualified opportunity, or a new SOW from an existing client); Ops tracks the opportunity and assigns the client-facing owner

values.label: Build, Sharpen, Scale.
values.body: Builds systems that reduce reliance on individual memory and manual intervention.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Automates recurring operating work when automation increases accuracy, speed, or visibility.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Protects both team capacity and client commitments rather than solving one at the expense of the other.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Surfaces operational problems early, names the owner, and creates a path to resolution.
